import re, math, json

# Login to simple_note
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
# find simple_note password
sn_pw = None
for p in passwords:
    if p.get('account_name')=='simple_note':
        sn_pw = p.get('password')
        break
print('simple_note_password_found:', sn_pw is not None)

# account username - from user? likely Tammy's personal email ta.weav@gmail.com
sn_username = 'ta.weav@gmail.com'
resp = apis.simple_note.login(username=sn_username, password=sn_pw)
print('login_response_keys:', list(resp.keys()))
print('access_token_present:', bool(resp.get('access_token')))
simple_note_token = resp.get('access_token')

# Use existing simple_note_token if available; otherwise login again (avoid if possible)
try:
    token_exists = 'simple_note_token' in globals() and bool(simple_note_token)
except Exception:
    token_exists = False
print('have_simple_note_token:', token_exists)

if not token_exists:
    passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
    sn_pw = None
    for p in passwords:
        if p.get('account_name')=='simple_note':
            sn_pw = p.get('password')
            break
    sn_username = 'ta.weav@gmail.com'
    resp = apis.simple_note.login(username=sn_username, password=sn_pw)
    simple_note_token = resp.get('access_token')
    print('logged_in_now:', bool(simple_note_token))

# Search for bucket list notes
all_notes = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    res = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='bucket', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
    print('page', page_index, 'returned', len(res), 'notes')
    if not res:
        break
    all_notes.extend(res)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index > 50:
        break

print('total_notes_found_bucket_query:', len(all_notes))
# show unique titles
from collections import Counter
cnt = Counter([n.get('title') for n in all_notes])
print('top_titles_by_count:', cnt.most_common(10))
# show all note ids and titles
for n in all_notes[:50]:
    print(n.get('note_id'), n.get('title'), 'tags=', n.get('tags'), 'updated_at=', n.get('updated_at'))

import re
content = note.get('content','')
# Find markdown checkbox items like [ ] text or [x] text
items = re.findall(r'^\[( |x|X)\]\s*(.+?)\s*$', content, flags=re.M)
print('parsed_items_count:', len(items))
not_done = [text for flag, text in items if flag.strip().lower()=='']
done = [text for flag, text in items if flag.strip().lower()!='']
print('done_count:', len(done))
print('not_done_count:', len(not_done))
print('not_done_items:', not_done)
